meta.name: http-api-cloudbase
meta.description: Use CloudBase HTTP API to access CloudBase platform features (database, authentication, cloud functions, cloud hosting, cloud storage, AI) via HTTP protocol from backends or scripts that are not using SDKs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过HTTP协议调用云开发平台各项功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在无SDK环境下通过HTTP访问云开发平台功能
copy.tagline_en: Access CloudBase platform features via HTTP protocol
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access CloudBase platform features via HTTP without SDK

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会通过HTTP API直接操作腾讯云CloudBase平台的功能，例如数据库查询、云函数调用、文件存储等，并自动获取OpenAPI文档来构造正确请求。
howto.when: 当你在不使用SDK的场景（如后端脚本、测试）中要求Claude调用CloudBase的数据库、云函数、存储等功能时触发。

say.text: 查询我的MySQL用户表，返回前10条记录。
调用云函数 myFunction，传入参数 {'id': 1}。
用API Key认证上传文件 example.txt 到存储。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will use HTTP APIs to directly operate Tencent Cloud CloudBase platform features such as database queries, cloud function invocations, and file storage, automatically fetching OpenAPI docs to construct correct requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to call CloudBase features (database, cloud functions, storage, etc.) via HTTP in scenarios where SDKs are not used (e.g., backend scripts, tests).

say_en.text: Query my MySQL users table and return the first 10 records.
Invoke cloud function myFunction with params {'id': 1}.
say_en.note: Claude uses POST to call the function.

say_en.text: Upload file example.txt to storage using API Key authentication.
say_en.note: Claude uses API Key as Authorization header.
